summary: MERGE PENDING — orch/attempt/onboard-dropin (af6a5f0, branched from dep onboarding-kb since deps 7/8's onboard-* scripts aren't in main HEAD yet; integrator stacks). Added scripts/onboard.js: drop-in entry that chains 3 miners -> onboard-learn.js (agentic validation) -> emits ONBOARD-REVIEW.md candidate-bundle gate, then STOPS. NO auto-inject — entry has zero HTTP/overlay/--confirm machinery, so injection stays behind the existing reversible [ingest] gate (onboard-learn.js --inject --confirm) and can't be bypassed. First-run idempotent via .onboarded marker (--force re-mines; --skip-learn for sandbox). skills/setup/SKILL.md §6: setup flow detects un-onboarded repo, triggers onboard.js, routes user to review gate before human-run injection. Self-test on orchestrator repo: mine->bundle->gate exits 0, writes bundle+marker, prints but does NOT run inject cmd; re-run no-op; --force overrides; graph [ingest] count unchanged (no mutation). node --check clean. Live checkout untouched.
